Prince Harry and Meghan to return to the UK

Prince Harry and Duchess Meghan are reportedly planning to move back to the United Kingdom, making it their "primary residence" after six years in the United States. The move is expected to happen within weeks. This development comes after a period of criticism of the monarchy by the couple.
